problem_statement: Phase 6B HIGH_PRIORITY_QUEUE top 5 all share the same topic (Flaws in the LLM Automation Narrative). The raw 25-post queue is heavily skewed by content-pack runs (5 variants per topic). Publishing all 5 duplicates would flood a single channel and burn audience trust. A dedup policy is required before any manual posting.

policy_rules.name: unique_topic_per_first_round
policy_rules.description: Each unique topic appears at most 1 time in the first-round shortlist (X or blog).
policy_rules.rationale: Avoid topic flooding on the first publish round; preserve audience trust.

policy_rules.name: ready_preferred_over_needs_asset
policy_rules.description: X shortlist must prefer posts with publish_status=ready (post text + image) over needs_asset.
policy_rules.rationale: Ready posts can be human-reviewed and posted immediately; needs_asset posts require an extra image-generation cycle.

policy_rules.name: source_type_diversity
policy_rules.description: Within the first round, shortlist should maximize unique source_type coverage (academic / ai-ecosystem / code / culture-art / dev-community).
policy_rules.rationale: Mirror Phase 6B's 5 source types in the first round to demonstrate cross-domain coverage.

policy_rules.name: prefer_existing_generated_image
policy_rules.description: When multiple ready posts exist for the same topic, prefer the one with linked_image_url (already reviewed).
policy_rules.rationale: Reuse Phase 6B canary/gen images; avoid generating duplicates.

policy_rules.name: needs_asset_routes_to_image_generation_candidate
policy_rules.description: Posts with publish_status=needs_asset MUST NOT enter the immediate X shortlist. They are routed to the image generation candidate list and only return to the X shortlist after image generation.
policy_rules.rationale: Do not publish text-only on a single channel when visual assets are a published norm.

policy_rules.name: blog_drafts_separate_shortlist
policy_rules.description: Blog drafts are kept on a separate shortlist, with priority=high or quality_score>=94 only in the first round.
policy_rules.rationale: Blog and X have different audience expectations and posting cadences.

policy_rules.name: no_auto_publish
policy_rules.description: All shortlist items are read-only artefacts for human review. No platform API call. No timer. No Telegram digest.
policy_rules.rationale: Preserve human-in-the-loop; honor Phase 6A/B boundary contract.
